user.title: Connect Impuls Fora UPS
user.description: Use the Modbus TCP settings from the UPS web interface.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read UPS measurements and status. Check host, port and unit ID.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Battery and generator energy
init.description: Enable only after verifying the battery branches. Two independent branches use the sum of each branch V×I. Battery calculations are unavailable while disabled. See README. Generator: select the MyAVR contactor sensor only if all loads pass through this UPS. Verify the wiring before including a separate bypass input.

error.generator_source_required: Select the ATS contactor position sensor or disable generator accounting.
